newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean old crop basis strengthens.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean old crop basis strengthens.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean basis bids were around two to three cents a bushel firmer on old crop supplies Wednesday while the corn basis remained steady.
Dealers said domestic soybean processors had been bidding more aggressively for supplies, forcing exporters to increase their bids in order to compete.

Nearby hard red winter wheat bids were also up sharply as the recent slow pace of producer selling prompted a lack of supplies. However, although old crop supplies appear scarce, new crop wheat should start becoming available in three or four weeks.
